models.name: Ross Animas
models.notes: Width, diameter, line weights and capacity from Ross's own Animas spec table (rossreels.com, now served at mayflyoutdoors.com/products/ross-reels-animas; matches Feather-Craft and Fly Fish SD). Rated capacity is the heavier listed line: 4/5 WF5+50, 5/6 WF6+75, 7/8 WF8+160 (lighter: WF4+70, WF5+100, WF7+180). Ross rates capacity on 20 lb backing (legacy.rossreels.com/product-help). Spool is estimated as rim − 0.24″. Trident lists larger capacities (e.g. 4/5 WF5+130, 7/8 WF8+225) that disagree with Ross; Ross's figures are used. Colors: Matte Black (shared black), Platinum, Matte Olive, Matte Blue; finish hexes sampled from Ross's product photos. Fly-shop exclusive finishes (Mardi Gras, Matte Chocolate, Merlot, Crimson, etc.) are left out. The drag knob varies by finish (accents): gold on Black and Matte Olive, copper on Platinum, silver on Matte Blue. The handle is wood on every finish.

models.name: Ross Evolution R
models.notes: Width, diameter, line weights and capacity from Ross's own Evolution R spec table (rossreels.com, now served at mayflyoutdoors.com/products/ross-reels-evolution-r; matches Fly Fish SD). Current lineup is 4/5, 5/6, 7/8; Fly Fish SD also lists an older 3/4 (3.43″, WF3+100/WF4+85) that Ross no longer sells, so it is left out. Ross lists the same 0.97″ width for every size, published as-is. Rated capacity is the heavier listed line: 4/5 WF5+75, 5/6 WF6+90, 7/8 WF8+150 (lighter: WF4+100, WF5+115, WF7+180). Ross rates capacity on 20 lb backing (legacy.rossreels.com/product-help). Spool is estimated as rim − 0.24″. Trident lists 3.525/3.775/4.025″ diameters and WF4+95, WF5+110, WF8+160 — close, but Ross's figures are used. Colors: Matte Black (shared black), Platinum, Matte Olive, Matte Blue (Trident also sells a Blackout edition, left out); finish hexes sampled from Ross's product photos. Evolution R Salt is a separate model, not added.
